title: Bluetooth Wireless Telemetry Hub
tagline: Cut the umbilical cable! Stream live analog instrumentation telemetry to any smartphone or PC over Bluetooth RF.

phases.instructions: Locate from your kit: Arduino Uno, HC-05 Bluetooth Module (comp_29), 1602 I2C LCD (comp_07), 10k Potentiometer (comp_20), RGB LED, 1k and 2k resistors (for 3.3V divider), breadboard, and wires.
verificationCheckpoints: 1k and 2k resistors for 3.3V logic level shifting

phases.instructions: Connect HC-05 TX to Arduino Pin 10 (SoftwareSerial RX). Connect Arduino Pin 11 (TX) through 1k/2k voltage divider to HC-05 RX (3.3V level). Connect LCD to A4/A5.
verificationCheckpoints: Voltage divider steps Arduino 5V TX down to 3.3V for HC-05 RX
LCD backpack wired to hardware I2C pins

phases.instructions: Double check the voltage divider on the HC-05 RX pin. Applying direct 5V to HC-05 RX can damage its radio processor.
verificationCheckpoints: 1k resistor in series with Arduino TX, 2k resistor to GND
HC-05 red LED blinks rapidly in discovery mode

phases.instructions: Review SoftwareSerial bridge: forward characters from smartphone terminal to LCD, and transmit potentiometer telemetry back to the phone!
phases.codeExplanation:
- SoftwareSerial(10, 11) creates a secondary serial channel without blocking USB programming pins 0 and 1.
- Inbound characters from smartphone are parsed and rendered onto the LCD.
- Non-blocking millis() timer pushes live analog sensor readings to the phone every second.

phases.instructions: Upload sketch. Pair your phone to 'HC-05' (passcode 1234). Open any Bluetooth Serial Terminal app, connect, and type 'A' to see it display on the LCD!
verificationCheckpoints: Typed messages appear immediately on the physical LCD

phases.instructions: Wireless Telemetry Pioneer! You freed your Arduino from USB cables with bidirectional Bluetooth communication.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Bluetooth Pioneer badge

variants.title: Dual Joystick Remote Telemetry
variants.description: Receive XY joystick coordinates from mobile gamepad app to steer pan/tilt servo cameras.
variants.wiringDifferences: Connect dual servos to Pins 5 and 6
variants.codeAdaptation: Parse incoming serial commands like 'X120Y45' and map to servo positions

extensionMissions.title: Encrypted Challenge-Response Link
extensionMissions.objective: Require Bluetooth terminal user to enter a 4-digit PIN before telemetry data is unlocked.
hints: Compare to stored PIN hash before streaming sensor values

story: Tired of tethering your robot to your laptop? Connect an HC-05 Bluetooth UART module to control robot servos and stream analog sensor graphs wirelessly to any smartphone or tablet terminal app!

troubleshooting.symptom: Garbled question marks or weird symbols on terminal app
troubleshooting.cause: Baud rate mismatch between Arduino sketch and HC-05 module
troubleshooting.solution: Verify bt.begin(9600) matches the module default. If module was configured for 38400, adjust bt.begin(38400).
diagnosticSteps: Check terminal app line ending is set to CR+LF
